input.summary: Delete the three-year USD 2M take-or-pay commitment.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept multi-year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination right, so we have deleted Section 2.1; if a commitment is needed we can look at the current 12-month term only, reducible on 30 days' notice with a true-up rather than a penalty.

input.summary: Extend the Services licence to Affiliates and contractors and remove revocability at will.
input.comment: [Playbook] A licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excluding our Affiliates and contractors is not workable, so we have extended the grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and limited revocation to the uncured-breach standard already in Section 13.3.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence to use the Services during the applicable subscription term, transferable to a successor as permitted by Section 13.3 and revocable only as provided in Section 13.3.

input.summary: Extend the Deliverable conformance warranty to 90 days with the Section 19.4 remedy preserved.
input.comment: [Playbook] A fifteen-day warranty that then cuts off all correction and refund obligations is below our floor, so we have moved to ninety days and kept the re-perform/repair/replace or refund remedy in Section 19.4.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation, and Vendor shall provide the remedies in Section 19.4 for any nonconformity Customer reports during that period.

input.summary: Replace immediate deletion with up to six months' transition assistance before deletion.
input.comment: [Playbook] Immediate deletion with no export or migration support is a walk-away for us and contradicts Sections 11.2 and 11.3, so we have replaced it with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, with deletion following the data return.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition, export, and migration assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, and shall not delete Customer Data except as provided in Sections 11.2 and 11.3.
